countryBasis: The South African lighthouse-service collection, showing the Robben Island lighthouse and keeper cottage, attributed on the card to Walsh Photo.; its documented1911postal use establishes circulation of the printed original, rather than first publication of an unknown old negative in1987.
datingExcerpt: An imprint reads Walsh Photo. The card was postally used (to a lightkeeper) in 1911.
sourceTitle: The South African Philatelist, Vol63 No9, September1987
datingWitness: Caption to the right-middle illustrated postcard in Harold Williams’s lighthouse-service collection. Original page and selected card individually inspected. Lower undated Robben Island card is excluded.

legalSources.basis: Photographs have a fifty-year term from publication or authorized public availability; a published photographic postcard circulating no later than1911is long outside that term, including at the1996URAA date.
The US95-year published-work maximum has also expired. No claim that the1987article or every archive image is public domain.

reproduction.sourceDigitization: University of Pretoria Department of Library Services2023; archive PDF
reproduction.method: Exact pixel crop from the native embedded page JPEG; no enhancement, inpainting, colorization or architectural alteration. The1987grayscale halftone reproduction is not described as a native1911photographic file.

limits: Only the dated photographic card is active model imagery. Contemporary article, layout, other illustrations and the undated second card are excluded.
No current paint colours are inferred from this grayscale reproduction. Colour and current surviving fabric are described in separate architectural text.
